"""Controller for VLABench play_math_game instance i00 (answer: 40)."""
import json
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

ANSWER = "40"
DT = 0.1


def get_state(robot):
    res = robot.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none")
    return np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float), res


def send(robot, q, fingers=0.04, rows=6, note=""):
    target = np.r_[np.asarray(q, dtype=float), [fingers, fingers]]
    res = robot.submit("joint_position", np.repeat(target[None, :], rows, axis=0),
                       dt=DT, interpolate="linear", video="none", note=note)
    return np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float), res


def quat_to_R(q):
    w, x, y, z = q / np.linalg.norm(q)
    return np.array([
        [1-2*(y*y+z*z), 2*(x*y-z*w), 2*(x*z+y*w)],
        [2*(x*y+z*w), 1-2*(x*x+z*z), 2*(y*z-x*w)],
        [2*(x*z-y*w), 2*(y*z+x*w), 1-2*(x*x+y*y)],
    ])


def rotvec(R):
    c = np.clip((np.trace(R)-1)/2, -1, 1)
    a = np.arccos(c)
    if a < 1e-7:
        return np.zeros(3)
    v = np.array([R[2,1]-R[1,2], R[0,2]-R[2,0], R[1,0]-R[0,1]])
    return v * (a/(2*np.sin(a)))


def pose(p):
    return np.asarray(p[16:19]), quat_to_R(np.asarray(p[19:23]))


def calibrate(robot, eps=0.04, rows=6):
    p0, _ = get_state(robot)
    q0 = p0[:7].copy()
    x0, R0 = pose(p0)
    J = np.zeros((6, 7))
    details = []
    for j in range(7):
        qt = q0.copy(); qt[j] += eps
        pp, _ = send(robot, qt, rows=rows, note=f"jacobian probe joint {j+1}")
        x1, R1 = pose(pp)
        dR = rotvec(R1 @ R0.T)
        J[:, j] = np.r_[(x1-x0)/eps, dR/eps]
        details.append({"joint": j+1, "dx": ((x1-x0)/eps).tolist(),
                        "dw": (dR/eps).tolist(), "q_error": (pp[:7]-qt).tolist()})
        pr, _ = send(robot, q0, rows=rows, note=f"return after joint {j+1} probe")
        if np.linalg.norm(pr[:7]-q0) > 0.08:
            raise RuntimeError(f"failed to return to calibration pose after joint {j+1}: {pr[:7]-q0}")
    np.savez("/app/output/jacobian_calibration.npz", q0=q0, x0=x0, R0=R0, J=J)
    with open("/app/output/jacobian_calibration.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump({"q0":q0.tolist(),"x0":x0.tolist(),"R0":R0.tolist(),"J":J.tolist(),"details":details},f,indent=2)
    print("CALIBRATION", json.dumps({"q0":q0.tolist(),"x0":x0.tolist(),"J":J.tolist(),"details":details}))
    return q0, x0, R0, J


if __name__ == "__main__":
    robot = Robot()
    q0, x0, R0, J = calibrate(robot)
    print("STATUS", robot.status())
